scope: Live pg_proc SECURITY DEFINER functions in exposed application schemas public and app, effectively executable by anon and/or authenticated.

methodology.effective_execute: has_function_privilege(role, function_oid, 'EXECUTE'); this includes inherited grants and PUBLIC.
methodology.public_grant: public_execute is derived from aclexplode(proacl) grantee=0; proacl is retained as raw ACL text.
methodology.body_scan: pg_get_functiondef() lower-cased; first_write is earliest textual INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE/TRUNCATE/MERGE/EXECUTE token. Direct auth positions are character offsets in lower-cased function definition and before_write is evaluated against first_write.
methodology.risk_order: critical/high candidates are static heuristics. Rank 1/2 means callable write token with no exact auth indicator anywhere; prewrite candidates separately test whether exact auth appears before the first write.
limitations: Dynamic SQL and transitive calls can hide reads/writes/auth checks.
A helper in the same SQL statement WHERE clause can appear after the write token but still constrain the mutation atomically (for example mark_notification_read).
Feature gates and customer context functions are recognized delegated calls for triage, but are not by themselves proof of authorization.
Body length and MD5 are included for reproducibility; full function source is not copied into the artifact.

findings.evidence: anon and authenticated effective EXECUTE; static INSERT; no direct auth gate before write; body has a global 200/hour ceiling and 30-minute dedupe but no CAPTCHA/Turnstile/IP quota detected.
findings.fix: Keep anonymous intake only if intended; add edge/IP rate limiting and CAPTCHA/Turnstile, bound retention, and alert on abuse. Treat this as abuse/DoS risk rather than authorization bypass.

findings.evidence: anon and authenticated effective EXECUTE; static INSERT; auth.uid is used after the INSERT token for attribution; body caps 300/hour and deduplicates for one minute, swallowing errors.
findings.fix: Keep only as intentionally public telemetry; add edge/IP quotas and retention, and ensure stack/message fields remain bounded and redacted.

findings.evidence: is_salon_member occurs after the UPDATE token inside the same UPDATE WHERE clause; this is not equivalent to an unguarded update but defeats naive before-write scanners.
findings.fix: Retain if intended; add a regression proving another member cannot mark the row read, and optionally refactor to an explicit preflight auth check for auditability.

findings.scope: 44 authenticated/static-write candidates with a recognized delegated helper before first write
findings.evidence: Authorization/context helpers include has_perm, can_module, c45_owner_loyalty_write, v89_platform_can, v53_customer_feedback_context, and v177_can_view_workspace.
findings.fix: Review helper definitions and call chains; preserve only allowlisted functions with explicit tenant/role checks and tests.

findings.evidence: The remaining rows are report_client_error_v177, submit_demo_request_v292, and mark_notification_read; each has an intentional or same-statement guard as described above.
findings.fix: Keep them on an explicit exception list with abuse/tenant-negative regression coverage.
